picks.name: SpaceX
picks.thesis: A new listing, so the quant signals are structurally meaningless — there is not enough trading history for 52-week, VCP or RS measures, and the 45 score reflects that absence rather than a judgment. Judge it on the business: the dominant global launch provider with Starlink now a material recurring-revenue subscription business, at a $1.86T implied cap and 91.9% revenue growth. TradingView does resolve a BUY (9 buy / 5 sell), but on only 19 signals versus the usual 26 — thin and unreliable this early. It closed at 141.29, 33.2% below its post-IPO high of 211.39 and right at its short 50-day (141.85). Position sizing matters more than timing here.
